Natalie Wang: hey team — completed my Okta invite and set up a passkey on my Mac. Okta shows me as Active but when I open most shared Google Drive folders I get 'You need access'. Also the 1Password app asked for device approval but the app says 'No pending approvals'.
Emma (People Ops): welcome! cc @Jordan (IT) — which folder(s) are you trying to reach? can you paste the drive link?
Natalie Wang: example: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CCompanyEngRuntime — email is natalie@redwood-inference.com
Jordan (IT): thx. Okta->Google group sync sometimes lags 10-20m. Are you showing up in the OKTA group 'eng-runtime'? i'll check the sync now.
DevEx Bot: provisioning job queued: gsync-worker-12 started for org 'redwood-inference'. job_id: gs-2026-09-12-43
Jordan (IT): Okta shows you in 'eng-runtime' group, but Google group 'eng-runtime@redwood.com' hasn't reflected the change yet. i'll kick a manual sync.
SSO Sync Bot: Manual sync requested by Jordan (IT). Result: 0 failures, 1 updated membership. Google group propagation may take up to 5 minutes.
Natalie Wang: still getting access denied. Also FYI 1Password enrollment flow on my machine keeps failing — the desktop app shows 'OneTouchVerification failed' when I try to approve the device. It didn't list a pending approval in the web admin.
Maya (Security): we require passkeys for high-priv groups — if 1Password shows an unknown error try re-enrolling from Okta: go to Okta > My Profile > Security Methods and delete/re-add the passkey. also check 1Password desktop v2.12+ is installed.
Jordan (IT): sync completed on my side. try opening the link in an incognito window or clear cache, google sometimes caches access errors. if still failing, paste the exact browser error string.
Natalie Wang: Incognito worked — I can access the Drive now :relieved:. 1Password still fails though, app shows 'OneTouchVerification failed'. Jordan — can you reset the 1Password device approvals for natalie@redwood-inference.com?
Jordan (IT): reset sent from admin console. you should get an email to re-approve the device and the desktop app will pick it up. if that doesn't work i'll escalate to 1Password support.
Natalie Wang: ok i got the email and re-approved — desktop app logged in successfully. thanks everyone! :tada:
Natalie Wang: quick q — who should I ping for SSH access to internal build machines?
Emma (People Ops): ping #eng-infra or @Jordan (IT) for immediate access. welcome aboard and happy first week!
